item.title: fix(telegram): show buttonless ask-user prompts (#130200)
item.summary: fix(telegram): show buttonless ask-user prompts (#130200) Telegram progress streaming treated buttonless ask-user replies as transient progress, so multi-question prompts could disappear without a visible delivery. Keep ask-user payloads on the durable question path and cover the owner boundary with a regression test. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
